description: The store campaigns (winkelacties) running at Belgian retailers, as read from the stores' own sites (dealio.be/acties/): a percentage on a whole range, brand or store, multi-buy (1+1, 2e halve prijs), cashback from the maker, a voucher, a gift, free delivery, loyalty-card deals, sales, no VAT, and announced ones. Not one product's price (that is search_deals). Each with store, kind, the advantage in a few words, what it applies to, condition, code, validity, whether it works on products or on the whole basket, dealio's link, and the promotions on dealio that fall under it (with their links). Filter by store, kind or words.

kind.description: Only this kind: btw (no VAT), procent (a percentage on a range), meerkoop (1+1, 2e halve prijs), kortingsbon (voucher), cadeau (gift), cashback, levering (delivery), klantenkaart (loyalty card), solden (sales), inruil (trade-in), aangekondigd (announced, not yet running), andere. Optional.

offset.description: Skip this many campaigns (for the next page).

q.description: Words to find in the campaign's title, what it applies to, its condition or code (Dutch), e.g. 'verf', 'Nivea', 'speelgoed'. Optional.

reach.description: product: the advantage is on certain products (a brand, a range, a category); mandje: on the basket, the order or the whole store. Optional.

store.description: Store name or slug, e.g. 'Kruidvat', 'gamma'. See list_stores. Optional.

name: get_campaigns
